name: Maruti Suzuki
description: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is the country's largest passenger vehicle manufacturer, known for fuel-efficient engines, the widest service network in India, and the lowest cost of ownership across segments.

name: Hyundai
tagline: Design-led engineering from Korea, built for India
description: Hyundai Motor India is the second-largest carmaker in the country, recognised for feature-loaded interiors, strong crash-safety ratings, and one of the most extensive dealer networks outside of Maruti Suzuki.

name: Tata Motors
description: Tata Motors is India's homegrown automotive major, credited with resetting safety benchmarks in the mass market and leading the country's transition to electric passenger vehicles.

name: Mahindra
tagline: Built for Indian roads, SUVs first
description: Mahindra & Mahindra is India's SUV specialist, built its reputation on rugged body-on-frame utility vehicles and has more recently combined that with modern monocoque design and ADAS features.
